queries.title: Product searches
queries.description: One product or keyword per line, as you would type it into Google Shopping, e.g. airpods pro 2, dyson v15, "nike pegasus 41".

maxProductsPerQuery.title: Max products per search
maxProductsPerQuery.description: Google shows 40 products per page; more than 40 reads further pages.

country.title: Google country
country.description: Two-letter country code (gl), e.g. us, gb, ca, au, de, in. Prices and merchants are for this country.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language (hl), e.g. en, de, fr.

minPrice.title: Min price
minPrice.description: Drop products below this price. 0 = no minimum. Dropped products are not charged.

maxPrice.title: Max price
maxPrice.description: Drop products above this price. 0 = no maximum.

merchants.title: Only these merchants
merchants.description: Keep only rows whose merchant name contains one of these, e.g. Walmart, Best Buy. Useful for MAP and reseller monitoring.

excludeMerchants.title: Exclude merchants
excludeMerchants.description: Drop rows from merchants containing these words, e.g. eBay, Mercari.

trackPriceChanges.title: Track price changes
trackPriceChanges.description: Remember each merchant's last price per search and add previousPrice, priceChange, priceChangePct and isNewListing. History lives in your named key-value store google-shopping-price-history.

onlyChanges.title: Return only new listings and price changes
onlyChanges.description: For scheduled runs: skip products whose price is unchanged since the last run. Skipped rows are not charged.
